FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Sweet Creamery Ice Cream Co., we specialize in crafting high-quality dairy and ice cream products made from the freshest ingredients sourced from reputable suppliers. Our core operations include a retail storefront where we serve a variety of ice cream flavors, dairy products, and desserts to our customers. We prioritize food safety by maintaining a documented training program for all staff, ensuring seasonal and temporary workers are well-equipped to handle food safely. Our commitment to quality also extends to regular maintenance of our equipment to prevent any operational breakdowns and to comply with local health regulations fully. Additionally, we implement stringent ingredient labeling practices and allergen disclosures to protect our customers and mitigate product liability risks. Security measures, such as surveillance cameras, are in place to ensure the safety of our establishment in a moderately trafficked area. We're proud of our proactive approach to loss prevention and consistently conduct risk assessments to identify and mitigate hazards, creating a safe and enjoyable environment for our customers.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Sweet Creamery Confections LLC, 23456 Dairy Lane, Suite 200, Ice Cream City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, we experienced a minor equipment malfunction that caused a temporary shutdown of our ice cream machine, resulting in $1,000 in lost sales and repair costs. The issue was promptly resolved, and we have since implemented additional maintenance checks to mitigate similar occurrences in the future. The status of the loss is closed as repairs were made, and we have resumed normal operations.

A perfect spot for a sweet treat after dinner. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting.
Their seasonal flavors are always a hit! I can't wait to see what they come up with next.
Great service and even better ice cream! The kids loved their cones, and I enjoyed a scoop of mint chocolate chip.
